input.answer: StatCan's quarterly population estimates put British Columbia's population at 5,710,598 on July 1, 2026 (reference period 2026-07). For context, the previous quarter (April 1, 2026, ref period 2026-04) was 5,703,683, so the population rose by 6,915 (5,710,598 − 5,703,683) in that quarter, a 0.1% increase (6,915 / 5,703,683 = 0.121%, rounded to 0.1%). Values are published in units, so no scaling was needed.
